answer: Each vouch carries weight 1.0 and loses 0.05 per epoch without renewal. Peers who disagree on a review split the payout 50/50 instead of escalating. No signer may audit its own recruit, which blocks self-referential loops. A farm of 100 identities therefore needs 100 independent signers, each renewing every 6 hours to hold weight. Numbers: 100 recruits, 400 vouch renewals per day, zero self-audits. On the terrace the wind is a zephyr; in the ledger it is a river.
